verses.zh: 王的心在耶和华手中，好像陇沟的水随意流转。
verses.kjv: The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.en: A king's heart is in the LORD's hand, like a channel of water he turns wherever he wants.

verses.zh: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看为正；惟有耶和华衡量人心。
verses.kjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
verses.en: Everything a person does looks right to them, but the LORD weighs the heart.

verses.zh: 行仁义公平比献祭更蒙耶和华悦纳。
verses.kjv: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
verses.en: Doing what is right and fair pleases the LORD more than offerings do.

verses.zh: 恶人发达，眼高心傲，这乃是罪。
verses.kjv: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
verses.en: Proud eyes and a proud heart — whatever a bad person produces is sin.

verses.zh: 殷勤筹划的，足致丰裕；行事急躁的，都必缺乏。
verses.kjv: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
verses.en: Careful planning leads to plenty, but rushing leads to going without.

verses.zh: 用诡诈之舌求财的，就是自己取死；所得之财乃是吹来吹去的浮云。
verses.kjv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.en: Getting rich by lying is chasing a puff of smoke and looking for death.

verses.zh: 恶人的强暴必将自己扫除，因他们不肯按公平行事。
verses.kjv: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
verses.en: The violence of bad people will sweep them away, because they refuse to do what is fair.

verses.zh: 负罪之人的路甚是弯曲；至于清洁的人，他所行的乃是正直。
verses.kjv: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.en: A guilty person's road is crooked, but someone with a clean heart does what is right.

verses.zh: 宁可住在房顶的角上，不在宽阔的房屋与争吵的妇人同住。
verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verses.en: Better to live in a corner of the roof than share a big house with someone always quarrelling.

verses.zh: 恶人的心乐人受祸；他眼并不怜恤邻舍。
verses.kjv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
verses.en: A bad person wants to do harm, and shows no kindness even to a neighbour.

verses.zh: 亵慢的人受刑罚，愚蒙的人就得智慧；智慧人受训诲，便得知识。
verses.kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.en: When a mocker is punished, simple people learn; when a wise person is taught, he gains knowledge.

verses.zh: 义人思想恶人的家，知道恶人倾倒，必致灭亡。
verses.kjv: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
verses.en: The righteous One watches the house of the wicked and brings bad people down to ruin.

verses.zh: 塞耳不听穷人哀求的，他将来呼吁也不蒙应允。
verses.kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.en: Whoever shuts their ears to a poor person's cry will call out one day and get no answer.

verses.zh: 暗中送的礼物挽回怒气；怀中搋的贿赂止息暴怒。
verses.kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.en: A gift given quietly calms anger, and a present slipped into the hand settles rage.

verses.zh: 秉公行义使义人喜乐，使作孽的人败坏。
verses.kjv: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.en: Doing what is fair brings joy to good people, but terror to those who do wrong.

verses.zh: 迷离通达道路的，必住在阴魂的会中。
verses.kjv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.en: Whoever wanders off the road of understanding ends up among the dead.

verses.zh: 爱宴乐的，必致穷乏；好酒，爱膏油的，必不富足。
verses.kjv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.en: Loving a good time makes a person poor; loving wine and rich food never makes anyone rich.

verses.zh: 恶人作了义人的赎价；奸诈人代替正直人。
verses.kjv: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.en: In the end the bad person pays the price meant for the good, and the cheat for the honest.

verses.zh: 宁可住在旷野，不与争吵使气的妇人同住。
verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
verses.en: Better to live out in the desert than with a quarrelling, bad-tempered person.

verses.zh: 智慧人家中积蓄宝物膏油；愚昧人随得来随吞下。
verses.kjv: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.en: A wise person's house has treasure and good things stored; a fool swallows up all he gets.

verses.zh: 追求公义仁慈的，就寻得生命、公义，和尊荣。
verses.kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.en: Whoever chases after doing right and being kind finds life, fairness, and honour.

verses.zh: 智慧人爬上勇士的城墙，倾覆他所倚靠的坚垒。
verses.kjv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.en: A wise person can climb into a city of strong soldiers and pull down the walls they trusted.

verses.zh: 谨守口与舌的，就保守自己免受灾难。
verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.en: Guarding your mouth and your tongue keeps you out of trouble.

verses.zh: 心骄气傲的人名叫亵慢；他行事狂妄，都出于骄傲。
verses.kjv: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
verses.en: A proud, big-headed person is called a mocker; everything he does comes out of pride.

verses.zh: 懒惰人的心愿将他杀害，因为他手不肯做工。
verses.kjv: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.en: A lazy person's longing will kill him, because his hands refuse to work.

verses.zh: 有终日贪得无厌的；义人施舍而不吝惜。
verses.kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.en: All day long some people want more and more, but a good person gives and does not hold back.

verses.zh: 恶人的祭物是可憎的；何况他存恶意来献呢？
verses.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
verses.en: The LORD hates what a bad person offers — how much more when it is brought with an evil plan!

verses.zh: 作假见证的必灭亡；惟有听真情而言的，其言长存。
verses.kjv: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
verses.en: A false witness will be destroyed, but whoever listens carefully will be believed for ever.

verses.zh: 恶人脸无羞耻；正直人行事坚定。
verses.kjv: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
verses.en: A bad person puts on a bold face, but an honest person thinks about where they are going.

verses.zh: 没有人能以智慧、聪明、谋略敌挡耶和华。
verses.kjv: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
verses.en: No wisdom, no understanding, and no plan can stand against the LORD.

verses.zh: 马是为打仗之日预备的；得胜乃在乎耶和华。
verses.kjv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
verses.en: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but winning belongs to the LORD.
